question: What is declared as kaula in the traishirasa doctrine?
premises: It is free from six circles.
It is devoid of all coverings.
It consists of knower and known.
inference: Kaula is declared as pure knowledge free from circles and coverings.
plain_english: Free from six circles, devoid of all coverings, consisting of knower and known: this is declared as kaula in the traishirasa doctrine.
